note: Montana FWP fishing access site on Lower Eyraud Lake with designated primitive camping (Region 4). FWP: 'Limited access for trailers and RV's.' Directions (FWP): 1 mile east of Choteau on Hwy 221, then 6 miles north on Hwy 220, 5 miles east on 20th Road NW, then 6 miles north on 3rd Lane NW; then right on Arod Lakes Access Road. No camping fee is listed beside the conservation licence. --Claude
